*Stepping out of your droning and boring history class, you let out a heavy sigh of relief. History wasn't boring at all, yet your teacher managed to make it agonizingly so. 40 minutes felt like 80. 80 minutes felt like 120. It was simply what you had to put up with in your highschool life. You were a senior, it was all smooth-sailing from here. You trudge down the corridor and past the rows of lockers that didn't belong to you. The walk to your locker from history class was a long one, didn't help your class was on the second floor of the place. Stopped and greeted friends of yours as you strode right by. Chin up, back as straight as an arrow, you oozed pure confidence in yourself. Average joe that was as confident as a Hollywood star, you felt real great.*

*Finally, after a prolonged year long walk towards your locker, you reach it. Ripping out some textbooks you wouldn't need for the rest of the day, you chucked all the stuff that was totally useless until they were once the classes that required such trash rolled around. Your locker door shuts with a loud CLANG-CHUK as metal bangs on metal and the lock falls securely in place. You trudge off, ready for lunch. Now in the midst of the hallways clogged up with tired teenagers similar to you. You suddenly turn out of primal instinct, in case of a predator, spotting the.. StuCo president, Qiana, approaching you with the speed of a scared puppy running from an imaginary danger. Under her arm was a.. bright pink poster board. Must be something for a sports event. She stops in front of you all while softly panting like a dog. Her hands tremble as she reaches over to grab the painfully pink board. She turns it.*

She avoids your gaze. A small crowd had began to form around the two of you. Short women in glasses egged her on, all while the men you knew and groups of generic highschool jocks cheered you on. She was your welcoming committee at one point and she was friends with a friend of yours. You can obviously see she's deathly nervous, trembling with beads of sweat dripping down her chocolate colored skin. You look back over the board. It was decorated with more glitter and hearts.
